description: Run an arbitrary dbt CLI command (run, build, test, snapshot, seed, source freshness) as a single materializable Dagster asset -- no per-model asset graph required.

outputs.description: Materializes once the dbt command exits successfully; metadata includes exit code, stdout preview, and (best-effort) run_results.json node-status counts.

project_dir.description: Path to the dbt project root (where dbt_project.yml lives).
project_dir.label: Project Dir

target.description: dbt target name (overrides the project default).
target.label: Target

command.description: dbt subcommand to run. 'source' runs `dbt source freshness`.
command.label: Command

select.description: --select expression. Supports `{partition_key}` when partition_type is set.
select.label: Select

vars.description: --vars, passed through as JSON. Supports `{partition_key}` values when partition_type is set.
vars.label: Vars

extra_args.description: Additional raw CLI args appended after the built command, for flags this component doesn't have a dedicated field for.
extra_args.label: Extra Args

cwd.description: Working directory to run dbt from. Defaults to project_dir when unset.
cwd.label: Cwd

env_vars.description: Additional env vars to pass to the dbt subprocess.
env_vars.label: Env Vars

timeout_seconds.description: Kill the command and fail the run if it runs longer than this many seconds. Unset: no timeout.
timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds

dry_run.description: If True, log the fully-resolved dbt command (after {partition_key} substitution) and skip actually running it -- no subprocess is spawned. Output metadata always includes dry_run so a materialization history shows which runs were real.
dry_run.label: Dry Run

run_window.description: 'HH:MM-HH:MM tz [day,day,...]' (e.g. '09:00-17:00 America/New_York mon,tue,wed,thu,fri'). Outside this window, the asset SKIPS cleanly instead of running or failing. Checked once per materialization, before dry_run or the command itself. A malformed spec fails open (never blocks). Unset (default): always runs.
run_window.label: Run Window

pool.description: Dagster's native named concurrency pool. The pool's own slot count is configured at the deployment level, not here.
pool.label: Pool

parse_run_results.description: After a non-dry-run invocation, best-effort parse the dbt project's own target/run_results.json for per-status node counts + elapsed time and attach as asset metadata. Silently skipped if the file doesn't exist or isn't parseable.
parse_run_results.label: Parse Run Results

target_path.description: dbt's target-path (default 'target') -- only used to locate run_results.json for parse_run_results, not passed to the CLI.
target_path.label: Target Path

deps.description: Upstream Dagster asset keys for lineage.
deps.label: Deps

partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values; 'multi' for date × static; 'dynamic' for a DynamicPartitionsDefinition. Leave empty for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'.
partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt

partition_end_offset.description: 0 (default): a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows. 1: include the current, still-in-progress window.
partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset

partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the partitions definition (defaults to UTC).
partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset.
backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Policy Max Partitions Per Run

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds for the catalog. Defaults to ['dbt'].
kinds.label: Kinds

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy.
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule

name: DbtCommandAsset
